name: DCA Fiddler, Fifer & Practical Cafe Roasted Turkey & Pesto Provolone Panini
brandOrRestaurant: Fiddler, Fifer & Practical Cafe (Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Sliced roast turkey breast, melted provolone cheese, and mild basil pesto pressed on artisan sourdough bread. Sourdough digests easily and provolone is naturally low in lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Pesto Panini warmed; hold raw tomato slices if sensitive to nightshades.
